## Professional Summary

Eren Kumcuoglu is a Turkish C-level executive with 19 years of experience leading high-growth companies across fintech, cryptocurrency, gaming, micromobility, and consumer electronics. He has served as COO, CMO, Acting COO, VP, MD, and Board Chairman — always with full P&L accountability and cross-functional authority.

His distinguishing trait is the ability to simultaneously hold strategy and operational execution — turning fast-scaling companies into resilient, audit-ready organisations without sacrificing commercial velocity.

Regulatory track record: Passed audits by Visa, Mastercard, TCMB (Central Bank of Turkey), and MASAK (Financial Crimes Investigation Board).

## Detailed Career

**Sector:** Fintech / Digital Payments
- Rebuilt operations, sales, and product strategy from the ground up
- Grew monthly transaction volume to ₺20B+
- Raised Ozan's issuer ranking from #22 to #5 (Turkey)
- Raised Ozan's acquirer ranking from #12 to #2 (Turkey)
- Established Pazar POS strategic partnership: +₺500M monthly TPV
- Led TCMB and MASAK regulatory compliance throughout tenure

**Sector:** Cryptocurrency / Fan Tokens

- Brazil National Team fan token: €15M raised in 19 minutes (fastest on record at the time)

**Sector:** Gaming

### Ininal — CMO (2016–2017)
